verdict.rationale: Gusto's own recurring scheduling is limited to payroll: custom semi-monthly pay schedules (gusto-docs-5) and payroll automations that gather hours and flag anomalies each cycle (gusto-docs-4). There is also a claim that a connected agent can prepare work before each payroll (gusto-docs-13), but it is unclear whether Gusto itself schedules that agent. missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of user-defined recurring jobs or workflows, documented recurring triggers usable via the MCP server or CLI, in-depth first-party docs beyond press-release claims, independent or hands-on corroboration.
